headline: Solara Active Pharma updates exchange on final reminder for unpaid call money
hook: Final call money deadline for Solara holders
summary: Solara Active Pharma Sciences has provided an exchange update regarding the approval of a final reminder cum forfeiture notice for outstanding call money payments. This administrative process impacts shareholders who have not yet paid the due call money on their shares. Failure to respond to the final notice may lead to the forfeiture of these shares. Retail investors holding the stock should check their payment status to avoid potential share loss.
whats_next: Deadline payment compliance by defaulting shareholders
why_it_matters: Unpaid call money risks share forfeiture for retail holders
